notes.title: Demo rebalance and bug fixes
notes.notes: [h1]Greetings, Defenders![/h1][p]Based on feedback and comments, we balanced the game, fixed some bugs and hope this patch eases the access of the Demo for people![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653030/cbbe1898545ee40fedbbd0bc4c54da040a838473.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h1]✨What's new:[/h1][list][*][p]More explicit illustrations are now animated![/p][/*][*][p]More animated Backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Quest descriptions in the quest log[/p][/*][*][p]Skill checks can now be rolled on the 'Spacebar' button! You still need to make the choices via mouse click, but we're working on that too.[/p][/*][/list][h1]🏰Tower Defense got a revamp![/h1][list][*][p]Opponents have been rebalanced slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Opponents now provide more Essence. Juicy![/p][/*][*][p]Towers scale more noticeable with Marty's attributes.[/p][/*][*][p]Two currencies: one for building, one for keeping[/p][list][*][p]This means that you'll keep all the earned money, but will not carry the starting essence to the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll have to arouse your enemies to get that sweet nectar![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Global buildings like the Cauldron of Climax and Grand Arcane Orgium can now be build a specific number of times during the TD Mini-game for further optimisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now see how much Essence they will carry over to the shop! A visual indicator is present![/p][/*][*][p]Death animations are now played for every opponent who is slain![/p][/*][/list][h1]🐞Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Certain bugs that impacted the gameplay have been fixed![/p][/*][*][p]All Character SFX are now influenced by the settings slider.[/p][/*][*][p]Music sliders in the options now work as intended and carry over from scene to scene![/p][/*][*][p]Dick Gobbler's shop visual bugs are fixed! You can now bask in all her glory![/p][/*][*][p]Music transitions between scenes are now fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h1]🪩Discord[/h1][list][*][p]We're actively discussing and sharing new stuff[/p][/*][*][p]New channels, improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Sharing the art and love[/p][/*][*][p]Consider joining[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for playing our Demo and on your feedback![/p][p]Stay hard and keep it cumming, Defenders![/p][p][/p][p]-devs[/p][p]xxx[/p]

notes.title: Day 1 patch is (a)live!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there pervs,[/p][p]First off, thanks to everyone who's played the demo, wishlisted, or just added Only Defense to their library. Means a lot. [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Here's a saucy gif as a token of gratitude:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653030/b1550ae51a593950b15c735affc8b15d89d57b82.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]So... We had one super-busy day fixing a shitton of fixes, some were big, many were small, we hope we didn't break something else, but it's possible, that's game dev.[/p][h1]Fixes[/h1][p][b]Now when that that's out of the way, here's what we fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some broken animations[/p][/*][*][p]Location backgrounds not working as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Rare dialogue bugs where a dialogue would lead to a wrong branch, or if it would break and lead to where it shouldn't. The game has a lot of text and branches, so it's [b]hard[/b] to keep it all in check.[/p][/*][*][p]Some tower defense issues[/p][/*][*][p]Save / load issues[/p][/*][*][p]Minor quality of life tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Some graphics improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New icon - hey, you can't say it's not pretty![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]So, what's next?[/h1][p]The [b]demo will stay yours forever[/b], no rush. We will update it as we develop the game further, but the scope of the demo will not change, as it's already about 1-2 hours of normal playtime.[/p][p]We will continue to work on the rest of the game. We plan to [b]release it until the end of the year[/b] - sooner the better, but we can't make any promises yet.[/p][list][*][p]There's a lot of dialogues and quests already written - more than 7000 lines so far - that's about the size of a regular novel. The full game will be at least 4 times the size of the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect many more perversions and animated sex scenes, as the demo is only the warmup.[/p][/*][*][p]5 faction leaders with 4 levels with 5 waves of tower defense, and about 10-15 buildings to buy and upgrade. We don't aim for the grind, instead we want to be more generous and make you feel more powerful as you progress.[/p][/*][*][p]We want to make all kinds of accessibility features, localizations, etc. but it will all depend on the game's success, and that's where you can come in![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]We want to hear from you[/h1][p]We are making this game because we love making games, and we're having a lot of fun with this one. But we also want to make a game that people will enjoy, so, we want your input (he-he)! [/p][p]If you want to hang out with us, yell at us, share cursed memes, pet photos, come and join our [url="https://discord.gg/nfGwpHPny4" style="button"]Discord[/url].  The community is still young and peaceful, but it's slowly gaining members and we'll share WIPs and stuff there.[/p][p]In case you want to share your thoughts, bugs, ideas, requests, but don't want to join the server, you can leave that in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3708000/discussions/" style="button"]Steam Discussions[/url] [/p][p]You can also comment this announcement - we'll read it.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's all for this update.[/p][p]- devs[/p]
